verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a public REST API. It covers creating verification sessions (POST /v1/sessions), polling decisions (GET /v1/sessions/{id}/decision), and HMAC-signed authentication. It also offers decision and event webhooks, a Postman collection, test integrations, and an llms.txt index for agents. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the probed paths, no independent or hands-on corroboration, and some actions (manual review, user-defined statuses) are documented only through the Customer Portal.
